---
title: "Working with multiple tables"
author: "Fabrice Rossi"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| message: false
here::i_am("dplyr-101.Rproj")
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(vroom)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
account <- vroom(here("Financial", "account.csv"),
  col_types = cols(
    account_id = col_integer(),
    district_id = col_integer(),
    frequency = col_character(),
    date = col_date(format = ""),
    .delim = ","
  )
)
client <- vroom("Financial/client.csv",
  col_types = cols(
    client_id = col_integer(),
    gender = col_factor(levels = c("F", "M")),
    birth_date = col_date(format = ""),
    district_id = col_integer(),
    .delim = ","
  )
)
disp <- vroom(here("Financial", "disp.csv"),
  col_types = cols(
    disp_id = col_integer(),
    client_id = col_integer(),
    account_id = col_integer(),
    type = col_factor(levels = c("OWNER", "DISPONENT")),
    .delim = ","
  )
)
```

```{r}
account |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 30)
```
